9 days until the August SAT.

Type your data into a list once, and Desmos will compute the mean and median and draw the shape. Nothing gets added up by hand, and no formula gets memorised.

Save this one — it's the whole topic in one place. Seva's practice tests have the same calculator built in, so you can drill these until they're reflex. Free trial — link in bio.

slides.title: Everything Desmos does for ==statistics==
slides.badge: Mean, median, shape, spread — from one list

slides.title: Type mean(L) and median(L)
slides.tip: Desmos prints = 10 and = 6. That single 48 drags the mean upward and leaves the median alone.

slides.title: Type histogram(L)
slides.tip: The same ten numbers, drawn. One long tail to the right is what 'skewed' actually looks like.

slides.title: Type boxplot(L)
slides.tip: The box holds the middle half of the data, so median, quartiles and range all read straight off it.
